        exact (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors

      have hx2 : x.2 ≠ 0 := by
        exact (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors
          (Nat.snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx)).ne'
      have hxy : x.1 * x.2 = n := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mp hx).1
      have hxyR : (x.1 : ℝ) * (x.2 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hxy
      rw [norm_mul]

            ≤ (CF * (x.1 : ℝ) ^ (ε / 2)) *
                (CG * (x.2 : ℝ) ^ (ε / 2)) :=

def SelbergClass.conjugate (F : SelbergClass) : SelbergClass where
  toExtendedSelbergClass
source_arguments.source_statement:
def SelbergClass.conjugate (F : SelbergClass) : SelbergClass where
  toExtendedSelbergClass
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
F.toExtendedSelbergClass.conjugate
  coeff_one := by
    change star (F.coeff 1) = 1
    simp [F.coeff_one]
  ramanujan := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := F.ramanujan ε hε
    refine ⟨C, hC, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    simpa using hbound n hn
  eulerLogCoeff := selbergArithmeticFunctionConjugate F.eulerLogCoeff
  eulerLogCoeff_primePower := by
    intro n hn
    apply F.eulerLogCoeff_primePower
    intro hzero
    apply hn
    change star (F.eulerLogCoeff n) = 0
    simp [hzero]
  eulerTheta := F.eulerTheta
  eulerTheta_lt_half := F.eulerTheta_lt_half
  eulerLogBound := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := F.eulerLogBound
    refine ⟨C, hC, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    simpa using hbound n hn
  eulerLogSummable := by
    intro s hs
    apply lSeriesSummable_conjugate
    apply F.eulerLogSummable (star s)
    simpa using hs
  eulerProduct := by
    intro s hs
    change Complex.exp (LSeries (selbergArithmeticFunctionConjugate F.eulerLogCoeff) s) =
      F.continuation.conjugate.value s
    rw [lSeries_conjugate]
    have hexp : Complex.exp (star (LSeries F.eulerLogCoeff (star s))) =
        star (Complex.exp (LSeries F.eulerLogCoeff (star s))) :=
      Complex.exp_conj _
    rw [hexp, SelbergAnalyticContinuation.conjugate_value]
    exact congrArg star (F.eulerProduct (star s) (by simpa using hs))

@[simp]

## Why interlacing is a possible engine rather than a conclusion

Marcus--Spielman--Srivastava prove that bipartite Ramanujan graphs exist in every degree greater
than two by selecting good lifts through interlacing polynomials.  Their later all-sizes theorem
uses expected characteristic polynomials of unions of random perfect matchings, real-rootedness,
and finite free convolution.  These theorems do not preserve an arbitrary prescribed trace packet.
The required new finite theorem is therefore:

> `[CONJECTURE: SOURCE-CONDITIONAL INTERLACING]` For the affine face of lift signings cut out by the
> completed prime-source nonbacktracking moments through depth `d`, the conditional expected new
> characteristic polynomials form an interlacing family and retain the universal-cover root bound.

If the source constraints are local under graph lifts, this is stronger than ordinary existence
but not visibly equivalent to RH at a fixed finite stage.  It would manufacture the needed finite
positivity through a combinatorial selection theorem rather than assume a Weil-positive kernel.

## 11. The tool for the open core: local polynomials evaluate to character coefficients

Let the modulus `Q` be prime, `m = Q - 1`, `g` a primitive root, `omega = e^{2 pi i/m}`, and write
`v_i = alpha(g^i)`, `v_0 = 1`. Expand `alpha` on `(Z/Q)^×` in multiplicative characters,
`alpha = sum_chi c_chi chi`, and index them by `chi_l(g) = omega^l`, so `v_i = sum_l c_{chi_l}
omega^{il}`.

For `j` coprime to `m` put `N^{(j)}(X) = sum_{i<m} v_{ij mod m} X^i` — the virtual local polynomial
at any prime `p ≡ g^j`. Evaluating at an `m`-th root of unity and reindexing `i' = ij`:

  **`N^{(j)}(omega^{-t}) = sum_i v_{ij} omega^{-it} = sum_{i'} v_{i'} omega^{-i' j^{-1} t}
   = m · c_{chi_{j^{-1} t}}`.**  `[PROVED HERE]`

So *the values of every virtual local polynomial at the `m`-th roots of unity are the multiplicative
Fourier coefficients of `alpha`, permuted by the multiplicative group `(Z/m)^×`.*

Consequences, immediately:

- `N^{(j)}` vanishes at `omega^{-t}` exactly when `c_{chi_{j^{-1}t}} = 0`. Hence **every** `N^{(j)}`
  has exactly `m - S` roots among the `m`-th roots of unity, where `S = #{chi : c_chi ≠ 0}`.
- `alpha|(Z/Q)^×` is a Dirichlet character **iff** `S = 1` (and then the nonzero coefficient is `1`).
- If `alpha` never vanishes on units then `deg N^{(j)} = m - 1` for every `j`, so `N^{(j)}` has
  exactly `S - 1` roots that are roots of unity of order **not** dividing `m`.

The open core is therefore the following completely finite statement:

> **[OPEN CORE, character-coefficient form]** Let `c : hat{(Z/Q)^×} → C` with `sum_chi c_chi = 1`,
> and let `alpha = sum c_chi chi` be an eigenvector of the additive DFT on `Z/Q` (equivalently
> `c_{chi-bar} tau(chi-bar)/sqrt{Q} = eps c_chi` for all `chi`). If for every `j` coprime to `m` the
> degree `< m` interpolation polynomial taking the value `m c_{chi_{j^{-1}t}}` at `omega^{-t}` has
> **all** its roots roots of unity, then `S = 1`.

Davenport–Heilbronn is the case `S = 2` with `S - 1 = 1` extra root, and that root is `∓1/xi`, which
by §10.2 is exactly not a root of unity. Proving that `S >= 2` always produces a non-torsion extra

local notation "serre_D" => Derivative.serreDerivative
local notation "E₂" => EisensteinSeries.E2

theorem eisensteinSeries_E6_tendsto_one_atImInfty :
    Tendsto (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) atImInfty (nhds 1) := by
  have hper : Function.Periodic
      ((ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) ∘ UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex) (1 : ℂ) :=
    SlashInvariantFormClass.periodic_comp_ofComplex ModularForm.E₆
      one_mem_strictPeriods_SL
  have hhol : MDiff (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) :=
    ModularFormClass.holo ModularForm.E₆
  have hbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) :=
    ModularFormClass.bdd_at_infty ModularForm.E₆
  have hana : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (UpperHalfPlane.cuspFunction 1 (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ)) 0 :=
    UpperHalfPlane.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero one_pos hper hhol hbdd
  have hvalue : UpperHalfPlane.valueAtInfty (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [← UpperHalfPlane.qExpansion_coeff_zero one_pos hana hper]
    exact EisensteinSeries.E_qExpansion_coeff_zero (by norm_num : 3 ≤ 6) (by norm_num)
  have hzero : UpperHalfPlane.cuspFunction 1 (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) 0 = 1 := by
    rw [UpperHalfPlane.cuspFunction_apply_zero one_pos hana hper, hvalue]
  have ht := hana.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (UpperHalfPlane.qParam_tendsto_atImInfty one_pos)
  rw [hzero] at ht
  exact ht.congr fun τ => by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      UpperHalfPlane.eq_cuspFunction τ one_ne_zero hper

/-- Weight-six defect whose vanishing is Ramanujan's `E₄` equation. -/
def ramanujanE4DefectH : ℍ → ℂ := fun z =>
  serre_D 4 (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) z + (1 / 3 : ℂ) * ModularForm.E₆ z

theorem ramanujanE4DefectH_mdiff : MDiff ramanujanE4DefectH := by
  exact (Derivative.serreDerivative_mdifferentiable 4 ModularForm.E₄.holo').add
    (mdifferentiable_const.mul ModularForm.E₆.holo')

theorem ramanujanE4DefectH_slash_SL2Z (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) :
    ramanujanE4DefectH ∣[(6 : ℤ)] γ = ramanujanE4DefectH := by
  have hserre := Derivative.serreDerivative_slash_equivariant
    (k := (4 : ℤ)) (F := (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ)) ModularForm.E₄.holo' (γ := γ)
  have hE4 : (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(4 : ℤ)] γ = ModularForm.E₄ := by
    rw [ModularForm.SL_slash]
    exact SlashInvariantForm.slash_action_eqn ModularForm.E₄ (γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
      ⟨γ, rfl⟩
  have hE6 : (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(6 : ℤ)] γ = ModularForm.E₆ := by
    rw [ModularForm.SL_slash]
    exact SlashInvariantForm.slash_action_eqn ModularForm.E₆ (γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
      ⟨γ, rfl⟩
  change ((serre_D 4 (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ)) +
      (1 / 3 : ℂ) • (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ)) ∣[(6 : ℤ)] γ =
    serre_D 4 (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) +
      (1 / 3 : ℂ) • (ModularForm.E₆ : ℍ → ℂ)
  rw [SlashAction.add_slash, ModularForm.SL_smul_slash]
  rw [show (serre_D 4 (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(6 : ℤ)] γ) =
      serre_D 4 ((ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(4 : ℤ)] γ) by simpa using hserre]
  rw [hE4, hE6]

theorem ramanujanE4DefectH_zeroAtImInfty : IsZeroAtImInfty ramanujanE4DefectH := by
  have hD : Tendsto (D (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ)) atImInfty (nhds 0) :=
    normalizedDerivOfComplex_tendsto_zero_ramanujan ModularForm.E₄.holo'
      (ModularFormClass.bdd_at_infty ModularForm.E₄)
  have hE2 := eisensteinSeries_E2_tendsto_one_atImInfty
  have hE4 := eisensteinSeries_E4_tendsto_one_atImInfty
  have hE6 := eisensteinSeries_E6_tendsto_one_atImInfty
  rw [IsZeroAtImInfty, Filter.ZeroAtFilter]
  change Tendsto (fun z : ℍ =>
    (D (ModularForm.E₄ : ℍ → ℂ) z - (4 / 12 : ℂ) * E₂ z * ModularForm.E₄ z) +
      (1 / 3 : ℂ) * ModularForm.E₆ z) atImInfty (nhds 0)
  convert (hD.sub ((tendsto_const_nhds.mul hE2).mul hE4)).add
    (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hE6) using 1 <;> norm_num

/-- Ramanujan's weight-six defect packaged as a level-one cusp form. -/
def ramanujanE4DefectCusp : CuspForm 𝒮ℒ 6 where
  toFun := ramanujanE4DefectH
  slash_action_eq' A hA := by
    obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := hA
    exact ramanujanE4DefectH_slash_SL2Z γ
  holo' := ramanujanE4DefectH_mdiff
  zero_at_cusps' hc := by
    rw [OnePoint.isZeroAt_iff_forall_SL2Z hc]
    intro γ _
    rw [ramanujanE4DefectH_slash_SL2Z γ]
    exact ramanujanE4DefectH_zeroAtImInfty

theorem ramanujanE4DefectH_eq_zero : ramanujanE4DefectH = 0 := by
  have hz : ramanujanE4DefectCusp = 0 :=
    rank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mp
